Common Questions

Things people
ask us.

Does it hurt?
Topical numbing is applied before the procedure. Most clients describe mild discomfort — you'll be back to your day immediately after.
How long does it last?
PhiBrows lasts 12–18 months. PhiShading can last 2–3 years. Results vary by skin type, sun exposure, and aftercare.
What skin types does this work for?
We assess your skin during consultation. Powder brows tend to work better for oily or combination skin. We'll recommend the best technique for you.
What should I avoid before my appointment?
Avoid alcohol, blood thinners, and retinol for 48 hours prior. No sun exposure the week before. Full prep guide sent after booking.
Can I get microblading over existing brow tattoos?
Evaluated during consultation. Depending on existing pigment, color correction or a different technique may be recommended first.
